note: reel_check (reel-check.md not released). Story type POLICY/subscription change (NEWS_MAP policy: explainer; stills frame used, no video reachable). Lead: digest 23:46 Dubai (TheGamer citing Epic). gate 20:45Z: Epic's own page returned 403 from the container; facts cross-read on TheGamer, esports.gg, GamesRadar, Dot Esports, TechWiser, all quoting Epic: from 5 Dec Crew has Core 1-2 months 1,000 V-Bucks, Bronze 3-5 1,200, Silver 6-11 1,400, Gold 12+ 1,600; price 11.99 USD unchanged; Crew Pack outfits end (December's pack the last), Legacy Styles kept; OG Pass ends 5 Dec; +20% XP; existing subscribers need do nothing. Hook: Fortnite Crew gets tiers. Why now: announced 4 Nov. Players here: price in USD; no Gulf pricing found, not claimed. Footage route: Epic Games Store content API gives official 4K art only, no video; stills in the horizontal frame; the art is from earlier seasons (Reload map, Festival character, a city street) so the credit names it as store art.
